correctness.rationale: Direct derivation gives unique singular point \([2:4:1]\); projection discriminant \(r^5(r-3)\) is nonsquare and conic normalization rational. Explicit basepoint-free quartic map satisfies the equation, is birational, and has one preimage of P. Local valuations of u and eta are 2 and 7; plane-genus equality establishes local semigroup \(\langle2,7\rangle\) and delta 3. Conductor exponent 6 and char7 truncated log identify Pic^0 with \(\mathbb G_a^3\). The accompanying polynomial program checks actual identities, not the abstract conclusions.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The point-count consequence is covered by Speyer and is not asserted to be new. His map implies rationality of the characteristic-seven function field after inseparability, so rationality alone is also not claimed as principal novelty. The extra object is the local semigroup plus connected generalized Jacobian of a specified singular model; neither follows from counts alone. Potential hidden broader model classifications remain a risk.
